newsitem.title: USA: Vivus shares rise after report in journal.
newsitem.headline: Vivus shares rise after report in journal.

text.p: Vivus Inc shares rose 3-1/2 to 39-3/4 by mid-morning on Thursday, one day after the New England Journal of Medicine reported the company's product, Muse, was effective in treating men with erectile dysfunction.
The journal issued results from a company sponsored, multi-centered study of Muse, or alprostadil.

About 1,000 men participated in the three-month test, which was the largest study ever published on men with organic erectile dysfunction, Vivus said in a statement. Almost 65 percent of the men treated with Muse reported sexual intercourse versus 18.6 percent of the patients on placebo.
